name: Leading People: One-to-Ones, Feedback and Hiring
summary: The half of the job no promotion prepares anyone for. One-to-ones that are not status meetings, feedback that changes something, hiring without theatre, and the conversations nobody wants to have.
prerequisites: No technical prerequisite. It assumes you have worked in a team and watched a project go wrong — the subject is people, and the examples come from software.
syllabus: The first ninety days: from doing the work to answering for it
One-to-ones: a meeting that is not a status report
Feedback that changes behaviour, and the kind that only relieves you
Growth: levels, expectations and the promotion conversation
Hiring: interview, calibration and the cost of getting it wrong
Difficult conversations: performance, conflict and letting someone go
